ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels covering approximately 65% of the visible surface with high-intensity (white) mottling covering approximately 35%, concentrated in the lower lobes and mid-left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region at the base and mid-ventral area of the left lobe; distinct white patch at the ventral tip of the right lobe; multiple discrete circular high-contrast rings (light perimeter, dark center) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; vertex is partially occluded by foreground water turbulence; estimated depth is approximately 15% of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration profile; left lobe features 3-4 deep, irregular indentations; right lobe presents a consistent sequence of smaller, high-frequency saw-tooth peaks; edge continuity is disrupted at tips by barnacle colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the central notch to the lateral tips; right lobe exhibits a more vertical sweep at the distal end compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Vertical cluster of three distinct circular high-contrast scars on the mid-section of the left lobe; approximately 8-10 scattered circular markings with high-intensity rims on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally and vertically across the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major V-shaped tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe; significant high-relief, high-intensity clusters of barnacle growth at both the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous 'bullseye' circular pigmentation patterns across the mid-fluke region, providing high-contrast focal points against the low-intensity background.
